### The Peace Offering
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/peace-offering
Passage: Leviticus 7:11-21
Points:
- The peace offering provided space for spontaneous praise, thanksgiving, and voluntary devotion under Mosaic law.
- Worshippers presented this sacrifice to fulfill vows, express goodwill, or celebrate deliverance.
- Unlike other sacrifices, worshippers were permitted to eat part of the meal in celebration with God.
- Purity regulations highlighted that God's holiness remains absolute even during joyful fellowship.
- Believers are urged to perpetually celebrate the peace established with God through Christ.

### Bible Pathways 2/3/2001
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-2-or-3-or-2001-550226.html
Passage: Leviticus 7:11-12, 21
Points:
- The peace offering established a shared sacrificial meal between God, the priest, and the worshipper.
- It was presented voluntarily in gratitude for answered prayer, fulfilled vows, or general thanksgiving.
- Strict requirements of ceremonial purity taught that approaching God requires true reverence and holiness.
- The offering portrays biblical peace as wholeness, health, and reconciliation in fellowship with God.
- This joyful fellowship points forward to believers being reconciled to God through Jesus Christ.
